title: StreamForge
summary: Windows stream schedule builder with Steam/RAWG search and Discord announcements. Download the zip, extract, and run — no installer.

blocks.content:
Service Diagnostics in Settings — see if Steam, RAWG, Discord, or updates are down, then Configure / Re-login / Retry from that row.
• Guild emoji picker in announcements — insert :name: and they resolve when you send.
• Tag roles and specific users in the Discord ping list.
• More reliable Discord setup (fresh login, clearer bot-token errors).
• UI polish: stream-day dropdown and diagnostics spacing.
